info.headline: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work - 10/17- 19th Avenue (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-16-2026 at 03:18 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct natural gas work near 19th Avenue between 59th Street and 60th Street in Brooklyn. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM on 10/17. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
